title: Abbotsford Police investigates bizarre incident
article: ABBOTSFORD (NEWS1130) - Abbotsford Police are trying to piece together how a young man ended up in someone's backyard on Rosewood Drive before going into medical distress.
Officers say Christopher Kampman appeared to be drunk or high around 3:30 a.m. today, physically lashing out and shouting things that didn't make any sense.
When they finally got him into a police cruiser, he turned unconcious and is now in hospital in serious condition.
If you know what led up to all of this, you're asked to call police.
